issue.title: Don't serve requests until startup complete

issue.body:
### summary

in the [starlette Events docs](https://www.starlette.io/events/):
> Starlette will not start serving any incoming requests until all of the registered startup handlers have completed.

this seems to not be true on `starlette==0.13.0` / `uvicorn==0.10.8`. noticed this as it caused a bug on http requests sent to a heroku app of mine when heroku container needs to wake up to handle request (https://github.com/zhammer/scribly/issues/16).

### reproduce

this is a simple starlette server that includes a 10 second `asyncio.sleep` in its startup handler, after which it sets `app.state.startup_complete` to true. (not to be confused with the actual startup.complete event, which i believe is part of the new asgi lifecycle.)

in those 10 seconds, requests to the `/` ping route _will_ be handled and the server will log that the `app.state.startup_complete` bool is still false.

server.py
```py
# server.py

import asyncio
import sys

from starlette.applications import Starlette
from starlette.responses import PlainTextResponse


app = Starlette()
app.state.startup_complete = False


@app.on_event("startup")
async def startup():
    print("starting up, will sleep for 10 seconds")
    await asyncio.sleep(10)
    app.state.startup_complete = True
    print("startup_complete set to true")



@app.route("/")
async def ping(request):
    if not app.state.startup_complete:
        print("Received http request, but app.state.startup_complete is not set to True!")
    return PlainTextResponse("pong")
```

requirements.txt
```
Click==7.0
h11==0.8.1
httptools==0.0.13
starlette==0.13.0
uvicorn==0.10.8
uvloop==0.14.0
websockets==8.1
```
